remarks: Welcome home to the Built Green Certified Tiguan model built by Daytona Homes—where smart design meets exceptional energy efficiency.  Designed for modern living, the main level features a seamless open-concept floor plan. Step into the bright foyer that opens directly into the spacious living, dining, and kitchen areas, making everyday life and entertaining effortless. Ideal for extended family or guests, the main floor thoughtfully includes a private bedroom and a full 4-piece bathroom, along with convenient side and rear entries for added flexibility and future potential.  Upstairs, you’ll find a massive bonus room that serves as the perfect central retreat for family movie nights or a play space. Two well-sized bedrooms share a full bath, while the primary suite offers a private, serene haven complete with its own dedicated ensuite.  Sustainable, functional, and beautifully crafted for your family’s future—Quick possesison available! (id:67522)
